description: Combine the alignment-based winners: typewell cross-correlation features (from exp003) AND DTW lag features (from exp006), on top of the baseline feature set. These two signals are complementary — xcorr captures linear similarity, DTW captures alignment under stretch — so combining them should beat either alone.
implementation_notes: Reuse the feature extraction functions added to src/features.py by exp003 and exp006 — do not re-implement; import them.
Two new interaction features: xcorr_minus_dtw_lag = typewell_best_lag - dtw_best_lag (when they agree, alignment is confident); lag_agreement_strength = typewell_best_corr * dtw_confidence.
Use exp_b001 baseline features as the foundation. Same LightGBM params as baseline. 5-fold GroupKFold by well_id.
Compare against exp006 (36.394) as the target to beat. If CV RMSE < 36.394, save as the new best.
